derived_rules.low_adoption: use_count_30d is supplied AND below the configured adoption threshold
derived_rules.recorded_net_value_30d: recorded_benefit_value_30d - monthly_recurring_cost only when both are explicitly supplied
derived_rules.proven_value: positive recorded net value AND adoption threshold met AND evidence threshold met
derived_rules.duplication_risk: potential structural overlap only; it is not proof that either product is redundant
